locales.description:
Content that rejects, misrepresents, or contradicts well-established scientific consensus without credible evidence.

Always verify that science information in social media posts is accurate before sharing it.
locales.name: ⚠ Science Misinformation

locales.description:
Contenido que rechaza, tergiversa o contradice el consenso científico bien establecido sin pruebas creíbles.

Verifica siempre que la información científica en las publicaciones de redes sociales sea precisa antes de compartirla.
locales.name: ⚠ Desinformación Científica

locales.description:
Conteúdo que rejeita, distorce ou contradiz o consenso científico bem estabelecido, sem evidências críveis.

Sempre verifique se as informações científicas em postagens nas redes sociais são precisas antes de compartilhá-las.
locales.name: ⚠ Desinformação Científica

locales.description:
Accounts that frequently engage in sharing sensationalized or inaccurate scientific content, or share science content without proper attribution or source verification. This content is frequently generated or paraphrased using AI tools, and may distort, oversimplify, or exaggerate original research for the purpose of maximizing engagement.

Always verify that science information in social media posts is accurate before sharing it.
locales.name: ⚠ Science Aggregator

locales.description:
Cuentas que se dedican con frecuencia a compartir contenido científico sensacionalista o inexacto, o que comparten contenido científico sin la debida atribución o verificación de las fuentes. Este contenido suele generarse o parafrasearse mediante herramientas de inteligencia artificial, y puede distorsionar, simplificar en exceso o exagerar las investigaciones originales con el fin de maximizar la interacción.

Verifica siempre que la información científica en las publicaciones de redes sociales sea precisa antes de compartirla.
locales.name: ⚠ Spam Científico

locales.description:
Contas que frequentemente compartilham conteúdo científico sensacionalista ou impreciso, ou que compartilham conteúdo científico sem a devida atribuição ou verificação das fontes. Esse conteúdo é frequentemente gerado ou parafraseado com o auxílio de ferramentas de IA, podendo distorcer, simplificar excessivamente ou exagerar as pesquisas originais com o objetivo de maximizar o engajamento.

Sempre verifique se as informações científicas em postagens nas redes sociais são precisas antes de compartilhá-las.
locales.name: ⚠ Spam Científico

Delivering digital safety and security services and products for individuals, businesses, and governments around the world.

locales.description: This label is used to mark content and accounts whose messaging is harassing, aggressive, demeaning, or otherwise harmful.
locales.name: Harassment

locales.description: This label is applied to content and accounts whose messaging is repetitive, unoriginal, or otherwise definable as "spam". This also includes "parrot" content.
locales.name: Spam

locales.description: This label is applied to content and accounts whose messaging is off-tone, crass, rude, bigoted, or otherwise harmful compared to the public opinion. By default, this flag is set to ignore, but you can electively use this to hide more content for a softer Bluesky experience.
locales.name: Disrespect

locales.description: This label is applied to content and accounts that center their messaging around politics in a charged format. You can use this label to help control the amount of political raving visible on your Bluesky timeline, while still seeing reasonable political content.
locales.name: Politically charged content

locales.description: This label is applied to content that we assess is missing critical context in order to be truthfully and honestly understood. You can use this label to control the visibility of content that is likely to be confusing or misleading due to missing context.
locales.name: Missing context

locales.description: This label is applied to content that contains requests for money or donation to an individual or entity acting as or on behalf of a charity, that we are unable to follow a paper trail to verify the authenticity of.
locales.name: Unverified financial cause

locales.description: This label is applied to content that is written in a serious tone, but that is a joke or is sarcastic, the punchline of which surrounds the usage of a serious tone which could mislead more literal thinkers.
locales.name: Satire

locales.description: This label is applied to content that is assessed to be a form of targeted or purposeful misinformation meant to elicit a mislead or otherwise misinformed reaction from an audience.
locales.name: Disinformation

locales.description: This label is applied to content that is likely to mislead or mis-inform a user without malice.
locales.name: Misinformation

locales.description: This label is applied to content that contains malware, spyware, info-stealers, unwanted code, programs, or otherwise dangerous content.
locales.name: Malware

locales.description: This label is applied to content that contains advertisements, websites, or other content intended to maliciously mislead a user.
locales.name: Phishing

locales.description: This label is applied to content that intimidates, threatens, or demeans individuals or groups based on attributes such as race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or disability.
locales.name: Hate speech

locales.description:
This label is applied to content that misleads, misrepresents to, or otherwise aims to deceive the end-user.

Content bearing this label should not be trusted.
locales.name: Fraud and scams

locales.description: This label is applied to content that is deemed generally inappropriate for the platform.
locales.name: Inappropriate content
